text: In Grantham County, Virginia, the coroner Tommy Tilden and his son Austin receive [an unmarked woman's corpse, found half-buried in the basement of a house of murders|threat|witchcraft and cursed things]. She has no outer wounds, yet [her wrists are shattered and her tongue cut out|images|wounded and changing bodies], and blood still flows in her veins. As they work through the night, the radio changes stations, the other bodies go missing, and [a fallen tree seals the only exit|rules|trapped with no way out], while the cloth in her stomach points to [witch trials of centuries past|wrong|the outsider punished].
